title: 第10章 旭日武馆第11章 闪电十三剑
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“不愧是外城两大武馆之一，这旭日武馆就是气派。”
齐源站在门口，看着眼前大气辉煌的武馆感叹道，此行齐源的目的就是为了旭日武馆的剑法，云梦城两大武馆，一个旭日武馆，一个金刚武馆，旭日武馆擅长剑法，金刚武馆擅长刀法跟拳法。
旭日武馆有名的就是闪电十三剑跟旭日剑法，而金刚武馆就是金刚拳法跟伏魔刀法。
这两家武馆在云梦城外城屹立不倒十多年了，靠的除了剑法或者刀法之外，就是各自武馆的馆主，十多年前两家武馆馆主在云梦城立足的时候就是练骨了。
凭借过硬的实力横扫了当时的诸多武馆。
两家武馆刚开始在云梦城立足的时候交过几次手，不过两家馆主实力相近，常常平手，所以之后也就基本没有动过手，虽然底下弟子偶尔为了云梦城第一武馆的名头动手，但也只是一些小摩擦，影响不大。
在武馆门口看门的两个弟子，注意到了齐源，其中一人开口道：“这位小哥，可是有什么事情？”
齐源看向这人，点头应道：“在下听闻旭日武馆威名已久，所以想要来此习武，还请小哥通报一二。”
门口两个弟子眼神奇怪的打量了下齐源，习武最好是十四岁左右开始习武，年龄太大的话习武很难有成就，太小就开始练的话容易伤身，齐源看起来二十多岁，早已经过了最佳的习武年龄，就算是日夜苦练，成就也有限。
像他们两人就是十四岁的时候进入武馆习武的，到现在四个年头了，碍于资质平平，也没步入练皮境界，才在这看大门的。
而以齐源这个年龄开始练武的话，除非家底雄厚，加上天赋不错，不然很难有什么大成就。
不过两人也没多想，毕竟有人来武馆习武是好事，至于能练到什么地步，那就看个人造化了，这就不是他们应该操心的事情。
两人彼此看了一眼，其中一人上前说道：“那你跟我来，我带你去见三师兄。”
说着就领齐源朝武馆里面走去，边走还边给齐源介绍武馆的情况。
旭日武馆分为见习弟子、正式弟子、核心弟子、真传弟子四种。
刚入门的就是见习弟子，需要通过桩功感应气血，等感应到气血之后会传授搬运气血的功法，配合秘药淬炼皮肤，踏入练皮境，就可以成为正式弟子。
等晋升练肉境界就是核心弟子，练骨就是真传弟子，真传弟子基本上就是下一任馆主的继承者人选了。
他们口中的三师兄就是练骨境界，真传弟子，至于武馆的二师兄跟大师兄，他们也没见过，别说他们了，就算是上一届的弟子，也没人见过他们。
大部分时候都是三师兄在教导他们，有的时候馆主也会偶尔教导一下。
据小道消息说，二师兄跟大师兄天赋比三师兄要强的多，所以很早就从武馆出师，到内城里面发展去了，不过到现在都没有回来过。

此时齐源也路过院中习武的弟子，有的正在站桩，有的正在演练剑法，其中剑法吸引了齐源注意。
只见挥剑间出现两道极快的剑影，招招攻敌要害，快速无比，带路的看门弟子也看出来齐源被这套剑法吸引，所以跟齐源介绍了起来。
“这个就是我们武馆有名的闪电十三剑了，练成之后出剑速度奇快无比，往往敌人还没有反应过来，就已经被一剑封喉。
而且练到圆满，出剑就有十三道剑影，让人分不清真假，就算能跟上出剑速度，也来不及辨别哪些剑影是真的，哪些是假的。”
齐源点了点头，从刘章那边获得的秘籍里面也有介绍，对武功的掌控程度分为入门、小成、大成、圆满，不同程度发挥出来的武功威力是不一样的。
看着眼前的剑影，齐源已经可以想象到练成之后用饮血剑的场景了，只要出剑速度够快，都不用一剑必杀。
只要被饮血剑伤到，凭借吸取气血的特性，这个人基本就死定了，就算是跑掉也不用担心，被饮血剑伤到之后伤口很难愈合，一个不慎就是失血而亡的结果。
“三师兄！”
就在此时，看门弟子朝齐源身后叫了声，齐源转头看去，一个身穿蓝衣，二十多岁的青年迎面走来。
等走到近前，看门弟子向三师兄说明了来意，三师兄石修诧异的看了眼齐源，然后点了点头：“好，我知道了，你先下去忙吧。”
“好的，三师兄。”
等看门弟子走后，石修对齐源说道：“我叫石修，这位小哥怎么称呼？今年多大了？”
“石大哥好，我叫齐源，今年二十六了”
石修一听眉头微皱说道：“齐兄弟，一般习武都是十四岁左右开始，晚一点的也是十八岁左右。这还是要大量资源练武。
以你这年龄，就算家里不缺少资源，恐怕将来成就也有限，不如再想想？”
齐源看着石修有些惊讶，武馆开门收徒除了扬名之外就是为了赚钱，好支撑练武消耗，这送上门的金钱居然还有不要的，看来要么是这人好，要么是这武馆不缺资源。
石修看着齐源的表情，也知道齐源心中大概在想些什么，于是开口说道：
“我从小就跟着师傅长大，所以在旭日武馆里面也见过不少年龄比较大的人来习武，但可惜都过了最佳的习武年龄，习武多年，消耗银钱众多，也只是勉强入门。”
“见得多了，所以有看到年龄比较大的，我都会劝一劝，免得多年辛苦，收获寥寥。”
当然，还有一层原因是现在旭日武馆确实不缺这点钱财，现在缺的就是天资好的。

齐源笑着说道：“这个石大哥放心，我也是练武之人，虽然不是很厉害，但是够用了，现在来这里，也是慕名旭日武馆剑法高超，所以想要来学习剑法。”
听到这话石修有些惊讶，看齐源气血不显，还以为没练过武，就是不知道实力如何。
石修犹豫了下，然后说道：“齐兄弟，我们武馆一般不收有师承的人。”
“石大哥误会了，我只是想要学习剑法，我出钱，武馆教我剑法，我们之间是很纯粹的利益关系，没有什么师徒名分，所以石大哥不用顾忌。”
齐源这话让石修一时语塞，不知该说什么好，石修这辈子还没听到有人说这种话，明明语气很客气，但是话听起来又浑身不舒服。
content_en:
"As expected of one of the two major martial arts schools in the outer city, this Rising Sun Martial Arts School is magnificent."
Qi Yuan stood at the door, looking at the magnificent martial arts gym in front of him and sighed. The purpose of Qi Yuan's trip was to learn about the swordsmanship at the Rising Sun Martial Arts School. There are two major martial arts schools in Yunmeng City, one is the Rising Sun Martial Arts School and the other is the King Kong Martial Arts School.
The Rising Sun Martial Arts School is famous for its Thirteen Lightning Swords and the Rising Sun Sword Technique, while the Vajra Martial Arts School is famous for its Diamond Fist Technique and Demon-Slaying Sword Technique.
These two martial arts schools have been standing in the outer city of Yunmeng City for more than ten years. In addition to swordsmanship or knife skills, they rely on the masters of their respective martial arts schools. When the two martial arts masters established themselves in Yunmeng City more than ten years ago, they practiced bone training.
With his excellent strength, he swept many martial arts schools at that time.
The two martial arts schools fought several times when they first established themselves in Yunmeng City. However, the leaders of the two martial arts schools were similar in strength and often tied, so they basically did not fight each other after that. Although the disciples occasionally fought for the reputation of the first martial arts school in Yunmeng City, it was only a small friction and had little impact.
The two disciples guarding the door of the martial arts hall noticed Qi Yuan, and one of them said, "What's the matter with this little brother?"
Qi Yuan looked at this man, nodded and said, "I have heard about the reputation of the Rising Sun Martial Arts School for a long time, so I want to come here to practice martial arts. Please let me know."
The two disciples at the door looked at Qi Yuan with strange eyes. It is best to start practicing martial arts when you are around fourteen years old. If you are too old, it will be difficult to achieve success in martial arts. If you start practicing too young, it will easily hurt your body. Qi Yuan looks like he is in his twenties and has already passed the best age for practicing martial arts. Even if he practices hard day and night, his achievements will be limited.
For example, the two of them entered the martial arts hall to practice martial arts when they were fourteen years old. It has been four years now. Due to their mediocre qualifications and lack of entry into the realm of skin training, they are here to guard the gate.
If you start practicing martial arts at Qi Yuan's age, unless you have a strong family background and good talent, it will be difficult to achieve any great achievements.
However, the two of them didn't think much about it. After all, it was a good thing for someone to come to the martial arts gym to practice martial arts. As for how far they can practice, it depends on their own luck. This is not something they should worry about.
The two looked at each other, and one of them stepped forward and said, "Then come with me, and I will take you to see Third Senior Brother."
After saying that, he led Qi Yuan towards the martial arts gym, and introduced the situation of the martial arts gym to Qi Yuan as he walked.
Rising Sun Martial Arts School is divided into four types: trainee disciples, formal disciples, core disciples, and true disciples.
Those who have just started are the trainee disciples. They need to sense the qi and blood through pile skills. After sensing the qi and blood, they will be taught the skills to transport the qi and blood, and use the secret medicine to temper the skin. Once they step into the skin training realm, they can become official disciples.
Once you advance to the realm of meat training, you will be the core disciples, and if you are practicing bone training, you will be the true disciples. The true disciples are basically the successors of the next gym leader.
The third senior brother in their mouth is the true disciple of the bone training realm. As for the second senior brother and senior senior brother in the martial arts school, they have never seen them. Let alone them, even the disciples of the previous class, no one has seen them.
Most of the time, the third senior brother is teaching them, and sometimes the owner of the gym will teach them occasionally.
According to rumors, the second senior brother and the first senior brother are much more talented than the third senior brother, so they left the martial arts gym very early and went to the inner city to develop, but they have never come back until now.
At this time, Qi Yuan also passed by the martial arts disciples in the courtyard. Some were standing and some were practicing sword skills. Among them, the sword skills attracted Qi Yuan's attention.
I saw two extremely fast sword shadows appearing between the sword swings, attacking the enemy's vital points with great speed. The guard disciple who led the way also saw that Qi Yuan was attracted by this sword technique, so he introduced it to Qi Yuan.
"This is the famous Thirteen Lightning Swords in our martial arts school. After mastering it, the speed of the sword is extremely fast. Often, the enemy's throat will be blocked by one sword before they can react.
And when you practice it to perfection, you will be able to draw a swordThirteen sword shadows make it difficult for people to distinguish between true and false. Even if they can keep up with the speed of the sword, they still have no time to distinguish which sword shadows are real and which ones are fake. "
Qi Yuan nodded, and the secret book he obtained from Liu Zhang also introduced that the level of mastery of martial arts is divided into beginner, minor, great, and perfect. The power of martial arts exerted at different levels is different.
Looking at the shadow of the sword in front of him, Qi Yuan could already imagine the scene of using the blood-drinking sword after mastering it. As long as the sword is drawn fast enough, it doesn't even have to be a single sword to kill.
As long as the person is injured by the blood-drinking sword, the person is basically dead due to the characteristic of absorbing qi and blood. Even if he runs away, there is no need to worry. After being injured by the blood-drinking sword, the wound will be difficult to heal, and an accident will result in death from blood loss.
"Third senior brother! "
At this moment, the gatekeeper called behind Qi Yuan. Qi Yuan turned around and saw a young man in his twenties wearing blue clothes walking towards him.
When he got closer, the gatekeeper explained his purpose to the third senior brother. Third senior brother Shi Xiu looked at Qi Yuan in surprise, then nodded: "Okay, I understand, you go down and do your work first. "
"Okay, Third Senior Brother. "
After the gatekeeper disciple left, Shi Xiu said to Qi Yuan: "My name is Shi Xiu, what do you call this little brother? How old are you this year? "
"Hello, Brother Shi. My name is Qi Yuan. I am twenty-six years old this year."
Shi Xiu frowned slightly when he heard this and said: "Brother Qi, martial arts training generally starts at around the age of fourteen, and those who start practicing martial arts later are around the age of eighteen. This still requires a lot of resources for martial arts training.
At your age, even if your family does not lack resources, your future achievements may be limited. Why not think again? "
Qi Yuan looked at Shi Xiu and was a little surprised. The purpose of opening the martial arts gym to recruit disciples was to make money in addition to becoming famous, so as to support the consumption of martial arts training. The money sent to the door was unexpectedly unnecessary. It seemed that either this person was good, or the martial arts gym was not short of resources.
Shi Xiu looked at Qi Yuan's expression and knew what Qi Yuan was probably thinking, so he said:
"I have grown up with my master since I was a child, so I have seen many older people practicing martial arts in the Rising Sun Martial Arts School, but unfortunately they are all past the best age for practicing martial arts. After practicing martial arts for many years and spending a lot of money, I can only barely get started. "
“I have seen a lot, so when I see someone who is older, I will give them some advice to avoid years of hard work and little harvest. "
Of course, another reason is that the Rising Sun Martial Arts School does not lack this kind of money now, but what it lacks now is good talent.
Qi Yuan smiled and said: "Brother Shi, don't worry. I am also a martial arts practitioner. Although I am not very powerful, I am good enough. Now that I am here, I am also impressed by the superb swordsmanship of the Rising Sun Martial Arts Hall, so I want to learn swordsmanship. "
Shi Xiu was a little surprised when he heard this. Seeing that Qi Yuan's energy and blood were not obvious, he thought that he had never practiced martial arts and just didn't know his strength.
Shi Xiu hesitated for a moment, and then said: "Brother Qi, our martial arts gym generally does not accept people who have masters. "
"Brother Shi misunderstood. I just want to learn swordsmanship. I will pay for it, and the martial arts school will teach me swordsmanship. The relationship between us is a pure profit relationship. There is no master-disciple status, so Brother Shi doesn't have to worry about it. "
Qi Yuan's words made Shi Xiu speechless for a moment. He didn't know what to say. Shi Xiu had never heard anyone say such words in his life. His tone was obviously polite, but his words sounded uncomfortable.
